verdict.rationale: Bevy covers the data-oriented side of the story through its ECS: all engine and game logic runs on Bevy ECS, with components as plain Rust structs and systems as plain functions. One community user also calls it a favorite for larger projects. There is no evidence of a profiler, nor of job/parallel task scheduling or instancing for heavy scenes. Missing for 10: a built-in or integrated profiler, job/multithreaded task system, GPU instancing for heavy scenes, and independent evidence of performance at scale.
